## Description
The exact-source Main→Staging integration [PR #3267](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/3267) is blocked by [Full Regression #42970306164](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42970306164) (attempt 1, integration SHA `6f8f5a4e411dd3ab74bc5bcd5ac3a8129cdc1ed2`). Native Job `full` ran canonical Playwright but the independent per-ID attestor failed. The original [Full Artifact #13834042105](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42970306164/artifacts/13834042105) shows `stats.expected=455`, `unexpected=0`, `skipped=0`, **`flaky=1`**.

Only `terminal-io.spec.ts:723`, *capsule arrow follows the cursor mode the PTY asked for*, was flaky (initial failure, retry passed). The initial failure at test line 751 had `PTY-PROBE READY normal` followed by `^[[A^Csh pty-probe.sh appcursor` **before** the shell prompt, so `sh pty-probe.sh appcursor` was submitted to the still-active `cat -v` probe. The retry passed because the race did not recur.

## Reproduction
Run Full Regression on a Staging integration PR (e.g., PR #3267 at SHA `6f8f5a4`). The test `terminal-io.spec.ts:723` ("capsule arrow follows the cursor mode the PTY asked for") initially fails at line 751 with `PTY-PROBE READY normal` followed by `^[[A^Csh pty-probe.sh appcursor` before the shell prompt. The retry passes because the race did not recur. The root cause is in `e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts::stopPtyProbe` which polls `/runner:\\S*\\$/m` over all xterm scrollback, matching an earlier prompt in retained history rather than waiting for the current shell prompt after Ctrl-C.

## Root Cause
`e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts::stopPtyProbe` sends Ctrl-C then polls `/runner:\\S*\\$/m` over **all** xterm scrollback, including earlier prompts. The first shell prompt in retained history causes the helper to return without waiting for the current probe to exit. This is test synchronization, not proof of an application terminal encoder defect.

## Impact
The Main→Staging integration PR #3267 is blocked by the flaky Full Regression run #42970306164. The flaky is test synchronization, not a proof of an application terminal encoder defect. CI reliability and merge velocity are affected; no application behavior or PTY semantics are broken.

## Fix Direction
Replace the historical anywhere-in-buffer check with the existing `lastNonEmptyLine(page)` live end-of-buffer shell prompt condition. Add a source-aligned regression assertion verifying that a stale shell prompt exists earlier in the buffer while `cat -v` is still running. Do not add sleeps, suppress retries/flakies, weaken Full/per-ID attestation, or modify app/PTY behavior. Deliver through a normal Staging PR.

## Location
- `e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts`
- `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts`

## Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 The teardown helper waits for the **current** shell prompt after Ctrl-C, rejecting an earlier prompt in scrollback, and the real `terminal-io` regression drives the normal→appcursor transition with the existing per-mode PTY byte assertions.
- [ ] SC-02 At a new exact-source Staging integration SHA after the repair, the canonical Full Regression attests `unexpected=0`, `skipped=0`, `flaky=0`, including successful `terminal-io` per-ID assertions. Failed, skipped, or flaky Full remains blocking; the historical failed run is preserved.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01 = SCN-02 (real Chromium + tmux-backed terminal, supported in native PR CI); SC-02 = SCN-05 (independently authenticated GitHub Full Run/Attempt/Job/Steps and exact-SHA E2E receipt, after merge).

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: merged
    branch: staging
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report
| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pass | run 42996216049; ref b7d5bb9777e377d57438f3fbeed357ffd50cd96e; source agent-qwen; file: e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts:380-389 — stopPtyProbe uses lastNonEmptyLine(page) with anchored /^runner:\S*\$/, polling the live end of the buffer rather than anywhere-in-scrollback; file: e2e/helpers/terminalRegression.ts:433-440 — lastNonEmptyLine returns the live end-of-buffer line, excluding earlier prompts; file: e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts:723-762 — test drives normal (startPtyProbe 'normal', asserts ^[[A and NOT ^[OA) then appcursor (startPtyProbe 'appcursor', asserts ^[OA), with per-mode PTY byte assertions; file: e2e/tests/browser/terminal-io.spec.ts:747-751 — regression assertion for Full #42970306164: historical prompt matches /runner:\S*\$/m while lastNonEmptyLine is not a prompt, proving cat -v still owns the PTY; summary: stopPtyProbe awaits the current shell prompt via lastNonEmptyLine (rejecting earlier scrollback prompts), and the terminal-io regression test drives the normal→appcursor transition with the existing per-mode PTY byte assertions, plus a regression assertion that a stale prompt exists while the probe is still active. |
| SC-02 | Pending | Awaiting new genuine Full Success at immutable integration SHA |

## Prototype

- Reason: existing terminal UI/interaction unchanged; real regression test is the evidence

## Product alignment
- [x] Preserve PTY-faithful terminal semantics and CI evidence reliability
- [x] Preserve independently authenticated Full E2E and protected merges

**Status:** Approved

Related integration acceptance: [#3205](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/3205). This Bug fixes a separately reproduced terminal E2E synchronization blocker; it does not replace or auto-close #3205.
